voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Tsarskoye Selo, Russia, nineteen forty-one. A palace room walled in carved amber, a gift from Prussia in seventeen sixteen.
It was taken down by German forces in thirty-six hours and sent to Königsberg Castle.
It was displayed, then packed into crates. In early nineteen forty-five, the trail ends.
Some believe it burned. Some, that it went by ship, or into a bunker. None is proven.
One mosaic surfaced in Germany in nineteen ninety-seven. The room in the palace today is a copy. The original was never found.
